snippet.title: BraveCart | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

It’s a Frosty Scoop with the debut announcement of BraveCart – a turn-based puzzle satire adventure that tells a classic Australian underdog story about mateship and resistance in the face of consumerism, duopoly and waste. See what obstacles, puzzle gameplay, friends and foes await when you take on the role of an abandoned shopping trolley and defy the twin empires of the legally-distinct Alphabarn and Omegamart!

Wishlist on Steam
